result.summary: Movie Gen 是一组媒体生成基础模型，可生成 1080p 高清视频及同步音频，并支持基于指令的视频编辑和基于用户图像的个性化视频 [abstract]。其最大的视频生成模型为 30B 参数 Transformer，最大上下文长度 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的视频 [abstract]。论文在文本到视频、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频和文本到音频等多个任务上取得了新的最优结果 [abstract]。作者还公开了两个基准（Movie Gen Video Bench 和 Movie Gen Audio Bench），并详细描述了模型架构、训练、推理和实验设置，希望加速媒体生成模型的研究 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在为 AI 系统赋予生成、组合和预测媒体（图像、视频、音频）的能力，这是一个具有广泛应用的核心科学挑战 [S1.p1]。作者希望构建一组媒体生成基础模型，能够原生生成高保真图像、视频和音频，并具备编辑和个性化视频的能力 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
We present Movie Gen, a cast of media generation foundation models.
Movie Gen models can natively generate high fidelity images, video, and audio while also possessing the abilities to edit and personalize the videos

method.text: Movie Gen 包含两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。模型采用基于 Flow Matching 的简单 Transformer 架构，在时空压缩的潜在空间中进行生成，并通过多阶段训练（预训练、监督微调）以及后训练过程实现个性化与编辑能力 [S3.p2][S3.p3][S2.p3]。

evidence.quote: Movie Gen Video. A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
Movie Gen Audio. A 13B parameter foundation model for video- and text-to-audio generation
We use the Flow Matching training objective to train our generative model.
We focus on simplicity when making design choices for all components in our foundation model, including the training objective, backbone architecture, and spatio-temporal compression using the TAE.
We add video personalization and video editing capabilities to our foundation Movie Gen Video model via post-training procedures

experiments.text: 论文在文本到视频、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频和文本到音频等多个任务上进行了评估，主要使用人类评估进行成对 A/B 比较 [S3.SS5.p1]。作者公开了 Movie Gen Video Bench（1003 个提示）和 Movie Gen Audio Bench（527 个视频）等基准 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS2.p3]。模型在约 100M 视频和 1B 图像上预训练，音频模型在约 1M 小时音频上预训练 [S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: Throughout this work, we use human evaluation to assess the quality of generated videos across various evaluation axes.
we publicly release a benchmark, Movie Gen Video Bench, which consists of 1003 prompts
Movie Gen Audio Bench is the new benchmark dataset we create using Movie Gen Video. It includes 527 videos
The model is pre-trained jointly on O(100)M videos and O(1)B images
We pre-train the model on O(1)M hours of audio

findings.text: Movie Gen Video 在整体视频质量上显著优于 Runway Gen3 和 LumaLabs，中等程度优于 OpenAI Sora，与 Kling1.5 相当 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。在真实感和美学方面，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，并在真实感上显著优于 OpenAI Sora [S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。Movie Gen Audio 在音效生成、音乐生成和音频扩展上优于先前最优，包括 PikaLabs 和 ElevenLabs 等商业系统 [S1.p3]。Movie Gen Edit 在 TGVE+ 基准上的人类评估中，被偏好程度比当前最优 EVE 高出 74% 以上 [S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond 2σ.
Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 σ) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).
On realness and aesthetics, Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics
Movie Gen Audio, outperforms prior state-of-the-art, including commercial systems such as PikaLabs and ElevenLabs for sound-effect generation
We demonstrate that human annotators prefer Movie Gen Edit more than 74% of the time when compared to the previous state-of-the-art on the TGVE+ benchmark.

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面仍存在伪影 [S8.p2]。生成的音频在运动密集、视觉上较小或被遮挡、或需要更细粒度视觉理解时有时会不同步，且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。此外，模型分别针对视频和音频生成训练，联合生成这些模态是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。作者还提到，使用人类评估定义客观标准仍然具有挑战性，可能受到个人偏见等因素影响 [S8.p2]。

evidence.quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense (e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded (e.g., footsteps), or when it requires finer-grained visual understanding
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
